name: Omega Mortgage Group

navy.role: PRIMARY — header pills, CTA bars, full backgrounds, logo monogram

near_black.role: Logo wordmark 'MORTGAGE GROUP', dark text on light backgrounds

near_white.role: Default light background, card fills, listicle backgrounds

gold.role: RESERVED — 5-star review graphics ONLY; never dominant in feed posts

white.role: Headlines and body over navy or photo

_color_zones_note: Disclaimer-band sample zones removed 2026-05-06. The pipeline no longer renders a baked-in compliance band — the dashboard's Footer Overlay panel handles it server-side via sharp + brands.compliance. Verifier should not assert pure navy at the bottom edge.
_forbidden_text_note: Brand wordmark + compliance/disclaimer text are added AFTER delivery (logo via overlay_logo.py if ever, compliance via dashboard Footer Overlay). The pipeline must NOT bake any of these into the image — Gemini's typography on small dense text is unreliable, and a misrendered NMLS number is a compliance failure.
_required_text_note: No image-burned text required. Compliance lives in brands.compliance and is rendered by the dashboard footer overlay at view time.

typography.display_serif: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond / Didot — used for hero numerals and topic headlines, mixed-case, italic for emphasis words
typography.sans_serif: Montserrat / Source Sans Pro — body, labels
typography.logo: Geometric sans wordmark stacked OMEGA / MORTGAGE / GROUP — NOT rendered into the image

archetypes.OMG_A_photo_hero_navy_pill: Dream-home / aspirational hero. Photo top half, near-white text panel below with small navy pill + serif headline + body.
archetypes.OMG_B_listicle_navy_hero_panel: Listicle on navy hero panel with cream content cards. Navy pill at top, cream cards below.
archetypes.OMG_C_numbered_listicle: OMG workhorse. Near-white background, navy pill, serif headline with italic accent, hollow thin-ring navy circles + navy numerals (NEVER filled), short list items.
archetypes.OMG_D_big_number_hero: Giant Playfair numeral as focal point + topic line. Used for stat-driven posts.
archetypes.OMG_E_photo_collage_hero: Multi-photo collage with text overlay panel.
archetypes.OMG_F_loan_type_hero: Photo + loan-type call-out (USDA, VA, FHA spotlight).
archetypes.OMG_G_split_photo_listicle: Two-column split — photo left, listicle right (or vice versa). Used for comparisons (FHA vs Conventional, Pre-Qual vs Pre-Approval).

hard_rules: Hollow thin-ring navy circles ONLY for numbered lists. NEVER filled circles with white numerals — that is the IEC/CSC pattern.
Navy #005181 is the dominant color on every post.
Gold #FDD314 NEVER used as a primary fill on standard feed posts. Reserved for review graphics.
DO NOT bake the brand logo, wordmark, or 'OMEGA / MORTGAGE / GROUP' text into the image. Logo is added separately after delivery.

DO NOT bake a compliance/disclaimer band. The bottom edge of the canvas should be clean (no full-width navy stripe, no NMLS text). The dashboard's Footer Overlay panel adds the compliance text after delivery.

Reserve a quiet zone at the very bottom (last ~10–12% of canvas height) — usable but not crowded — so compliance text can be overlaid without colliding with key content. This is a soft design intent, not a solid-color reserve.
No 'APPLY NOW' / 'LIMITED TIME' / hard-sell language burned into images.
Photography: real, warm, inclusive families. NEVER stock-cheesy or fintech-flat illustration.

compliance_handling._why: Compliance text changes (license updates, state additions). Dashboard-rendering keeps it editable in one place; baking it into every render forces re-generation when legal copy changes.

_source: merged from dashboard.brands + existing brand_contract.json + restructure
